info.title: GolfAPI.dev club catalog
info.description: Read-only catalog of golf clubs and the components they are built from. Every endpoint is a GET. Authentication is a bearer key whose entitlements decide which resources and which document depth it may read. `Golfapi-Version` names the response shape by date. One version is served, it is every Golfapi-Version default in this document, and any other date is 400. `info.version` is this document's own release number and is not a shape date -- the two never need to agree. Requests are rate-limited to 60 per account, across all its keys, per 60-second wall-clock window by default; `RateLimit-Limit`, `RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset` are set after a key enters an authenticated resource chain, including its 403 and 429 responses; an account's own cap can differ, a 304 is refunded and reports the refunded budget, any other 4xx except 429 is refunded from the monthly quota but counts against the per-minute limit, an address that sends more than 30 unaccepted keys a minute gets 429, and `GET /` names the default under `rate_limit` without carrying those headers. This document defines the current response contract. Free reads sandbox data. Hobby reads specs (view=core) for every club. Pro adds launch prices (view=market). Club-builder (view=expanded) is available on Enterprise.

get.description: Filters combine with AND. No matches returns data: []. Unknown or repeated query parameters return 400. Results are ordered by release_year descending, then club ID descending; q orders by relevance first. Core is the default unless view or fields selects another permitted document.

parameters.name: Golfapi-Version
parameters.description: API version. 2026-10-02 is the only version served, and the default when the header is omitted. Any other date is 400, including the retired versions `GET /` lists under `version.retired`. A malformed date is 400.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response document: core, expanded or market. Core is the default unless fields selects another document. The legacy token basic is accepted as core. Expanded requires club-builder (Enterprise); Market requires market (Pro plan). Missing access returns 403. Read Golfapi-View for the document served.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated top-level fields from one response document. id is always returned. Without an explicit view, a Club-builder field selects expanded and intro_price selects market. Missing club-builder or market access returns 403; market (intro_price) needs the Pro plan. An unknown field, a field outside an explicit view, or a selection mixing Club-builder and Market fields returns 400.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque pagination token from page.next. Send it unchanged on the same resource, with the same filters, served version and key access. Page size may change between requests. On a cursor 400, restart the scan.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: ETag retained for this exact representation URL and version. A 304 is not charged against the rate limit, and its RateLimit-Remaining names the budget after that refund.

parameters.name: manufacturer
parameters.description: Manufacturer slug.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Family slug.

parameters.name: hand
parameters.description: Offered hand.

parameters.name: designation
parameters.description: Heads whose designations includes this value. Each model is returned once. An empty result means no matching published record; an omitted designations field has no published classification.

parameters.name: loft
parameters.description: Nominal loft in degrees. The value must occur in the requested collection; otherwise the API returns 400 with that collection’s published lofts. A loft available only in another collection is invalid here. With hand, both must match the same variant: hand=lh&loft=10.5 returns clubs sold left-handed at 10.5 degrees.

parameters.name: adjustable_hosel
parameters.description: Whether the hosel adjusts.

parameters.name: release_year
parameters.description: Release year, four digits.

parameters.name: release_year_after
parameters.description: Inclusive earliest release year, four digits.

parameters.name: release_year_before
parameters.description: Inclusive latest release year, four digits.

parameters.name: released_after
parameters.description: Inclusive earliest exact retail date. Matches only records with an exact `released` date; a record that carries only `release_year` never matches. A window whose start is later than released_before is 400: the two parameters contradict each other, which is not the same answer as a window that merely matches nothing.

parameters.name: released_before
parameters.description: Inclusive latest exact retail date. Matches only records with an exact `released` date. Equal bounds are a legal one-day window.

parameters.name: msrp_min
parameters.description: Inclusive lowest launch MSRP in the market `msrp_market` names (US when absent), in that currency's minor units: 50000 is $500 in the US and Y50,000 in JP, since JPY has no minor unit. A club with no launch price in that market never matches. Pro plan: needs the 'market' entitlement (403 without it), on any view. Greater than msrp_max is 400.

parameters.name: msrp_max
parameters.description: Inclusive highest launch MSRP in the market `msrp_market` names (US when absent), in that currency's minor units: 50000 is $500 in the US and Y50,000 in JP. A club with no launch price in that market never matches. Pro plan: needs the 'market' entitlement (403 without it), on any view.

parameters.name: msrp_market
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 market whose `intro_price` entry msrp_min and msrp_max compare, in its own currency; US when absent. Prices are never converted between currencies. Alone, it keeps the clubs with a launch price in that market. A market the published catalog has no price in is 400, naming the markets it prices. Pro plan: needs the 'market' entitlement (403 without it).

parameters.name: release_type
parameters.description: Which classes to list: 'all', or a comma-separated list of retail, limited, tour and prototype. Default retail,limited, so tour builds and prototypes appear only when named. Applies to q search too. Detail routes serve every class.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search names, manufacturers, families, and generated aliases. Case and accents are folded. Every word must match the start of an indexed word, so `pxg 034` finds the 0341. Slot shorthand (`3w`, `7i`, `4h`, `sw`, and a number before a slot word, as in `3 wood`) is ignored on every club type except putters. Prefix, alias, and similarity matches can add rows that do not contain every word. A non-empty page does not identify a club; fetch a chosen hit with GET /{resource}/{id-or-slug}. Control characters are invalid.
